_doc: Vendored/manually-installed GitHub deps we run OUTSIDE a package manager, so nothing tells us when upstream ships an update. vendored_deps_check.py gh-api's each repo's latest release/tag vs our pinned `current` + flags stale. On a stale flag: respect the 7-day age gate + run check_standdown.py <repo> BEFORE updating. managed_by=manual are the real targets (clone/build/release-bin); package-manager-managed deps self-update via their own tooling (tracked for completeness). Add a dep here whenever you adopt one from GitHub outside a package manager. To enable an entry's check, fill `repo` (owner/name) + pin `current`.
